author: /root/proof_inventory
scope: The exact original n-or-n+1 cell of any point and a fixed index shift transfer a model power to any actual material cell containing the same scaled point.
The actual N06 fixed arrival-cap lower bound gives the reciprocal length of the same scaled gap at its real physical midpoint cell. Constants precede all gaps and cell choices.
The two dilation factors and the cell/index transport identities are explicit inputs. The next retained-coordinate adapter will derive them for the same constructed witness.
No whole positive component is assumed to lie in a single cell; no arbitrary Through03 retention, raw optical lower, material weight enlargement or E0>=1 is used.
